identity_correspondence.seeding: Untransformed captured values are deep-copied before mask/parse transforms. Capture JSON paths and endpoint/entity context determine integer scope; matching structural positions extend the same forward and reverse maps. Conflicting mapped values or reverse reuse yield DATA at that path with reason identity mismatch
identity_correspondence.unordered: Opt-in arrays match complete identity-agnostic canonical multiset elements first, then verify each candidate pair's identity map. Distinct possible bijections fail as ambiguous identity correspondence; repeated identical rows retain multiplicity. Unmatched inventories remain ordinary complete data differences and do not establish identities
identity_correspondence.embedded_json_and_keys: Opted-in parse_json retains raw identifiers inside parsed-string wrappers, preserving wire string-vs-object type. Opted-in normalized Lombok entity keys become field-bearing multiset entries so key ids and value references share the journey map
identity_correspondence.literals_and_clocks: Non-generated fixture strings such as sweep-admin and ordinary numeric fields still compare literally. Clock values retain their existing shape masking
identity_correspondence.not_proven: Explicitly masked fields, non-opted-in JSON strings/entity-toString keys, unmatched rows, unknown generated shapes and unobserved intended relationships are outside identity correspondence; first observations cannot establish intended graph semantics or detect a bug common to both stacks
